citations.quote: only when such LC is not acting as a Transfer Agent.
Would activities that an RA 13 depositary performs in its capacity as a Transfer Agent (TA) (eg, processing payments in designated accounts) be subject to requirements under the CMR?

In such cases, the depositary is expected to observe relevant requirements under Schedule 11 to the Code of Conduct for Persons Licensed by or Registered with the Securities and Futures Commission (Schedule 11), in particular paragraphs 9 (relating to how subscription and redemption proceeds should be held) and 11 (relating to distribution proceeds).

readings.distinction: Activity-specific attachment: “not” negates acting as a Transfer Agent in the handling being assessed. Q1 expressly asks about activities performed in that capacity, which supports this reading. The rival entity-wide reading remains textually possible because “such LC” does not expressly repeat the activity limitation.

citations.quote: The CMR will apply to an RA 13 licensed corporation (LC) and its associated entity (AE) in respect of “scheme money” received or held in Hong Kong by the RA 13 LC or its AE in the course of conducting Type 13 regulated activity by the RA 13 LC, only when such LC is not acting as a Transfer Agent.

In general, if a bank account is opened in the name of, and maintained by, the RA 13 LC, money forming part of the REIT’s property deposited in that account would be considered scheme money received or held by the RA 13 LC and the CMR requirements will apply.

readings.distinction: Entity-wide attachment: the LC fails the antecedent if it is concurrently acting as a Transfer Agent in any activity, even unrelated activity. “Such LC” permits this literal reading, although Q1’s activity-specific framing weighs against it. The fixed vocabulary cannot encode this scope faithfully.

vocabulary_concerns: transfer_agent lacks an activity, fund, capacity, entity-aggregation and time index, so the fixed vocabulary cannot independently distinguish activity-specific from entity-wide readings.

ra13_context combines actor identity, association and handling in the course of RA13; it cannot separately test LC-held and AE-held money while preserving the qualification’s express reference to the LC.
scheme_money depends on incorporated legislation not supplied here and remains an external classification.
in_hong_kong must concern receipt or holding of the same assessed money by the relevant LC or AE; independent Boolean values could otherwise combine different actors, funds or times.
The Boolean expression tests satisfaction of selected conditions and cannot itself represent the necessary-versus-sufficient force of “only when.”
No fact represents Schedule 11 duties, their modality, their satisfaction or the referent of “In such cases”; a false result is not a whole-law exemption.
Q2 timing and unknown-receipt qualifications, and Q3’s account and SPV qualifications, cannot be encoded with these inputs and must not silently become additional Q1 conjuncts.
